text:
The brief year of mortal life carries everything away, mocking brave steel and cold marble, whose hardness dares resist Time.


Before the foot knows how to walk, it moves toward death, where I send my obscure life: a poor, turbid river drunk by a black sea with towering waves.


Every short moment is a long step I unwillingly take on that journey, for standing still and sleeping, I always hurry on.


Death is a brief, final, bitter sigh, compulsory and inherited; but if it is law and not punishment, why do I grieve?

translation.title: The Brief Year Carries Everything Away
